content:
这首歌是Apocalypse～dirge of swans～来自于Konami的Beatmania IIDX 13 DistorteD Orignal Soundtrack很像是首挽歌
歌词很美
Apocalypse～dirge of swans～
启示录～天鹅的挽歌～

Swans sing before they die
天鹅临死之前会放声歌唱
Their songs resound throughout the sky
它们的歌声响彻天际
And I drop a rose petal
我掉落了一片玫瑰花瓣
Down the sea of blood and tears
沉于血与泪的海洋
I keep praying
我不断在祈祷
Why do you injured one another?
为什么你们伤害彼此?
Why?
为什么?
Aggressive culture of despotism
专制侵略的文化
Why?
为什么?
you never win the cursed war
你无法赢得这被诅咒的战争
Glory
荣誉
Decline
衰落
Delusion
妄想
Arrogance
傲慢
Silence
缄默
Anger
愤怒
Silence
寂静
Madness
疯狂
Now the fire has burnt out
火焰已渐燃烧殆尽
And what is left is built of ice
剩下的残垣也被冰雪所覆盖
This sounds like heaven
这声音如同天籁
I vaguely hear a moan of pain
我隐约听到痛苦的呻吟声
It's a solemn note
这是一个庄严的音符
